references.text: Moses complains that the burden of leading the people is too heavy for him alone, reflecting the same theme that one person cannot bear responsibility alone.
Moses acknowledges that he cannot carry the people alone and that the burden is too heavy, the same principle Jethro points out.
Instructions about judges who will help with difficult cases, as a solution to the problem of one person not being able to judge everything alone.
The apostles realize they cannot do everything themselves and delegate tasks to others, the same principle of division of labor in leadership.
God takes some of the Spirit that is on Moses and places it on seventy elders to share the burden of leadership.
Moses' own confession of his inability is the direct continuation of Jethro's warning in Exodus 18.
This is God's concrete answer and solution to the unbearable burden described in Exodus 18:18.
